enriched_description: Very large rough-coated hound measuring 76-86 cm at shoulder and weighing 48-70 kg, tallest of all dog breeds. Head is long and flat with slight stop and moderate length square muzzle. Ears are small, rose-shaped (folded back), and set high. Eyes are dark and alert. Body is muscular and powerful with deep chest, level topline, and slight tuck-up. Coat is rough, hard, wiry, and dense, ranging from grey, brindle, red, black, white, to wheaten. Neck is long and muscular with slight arch. Tail is long, slightly curved, and well-covered with hair. Legs are straight, heavy-boned, and muscular with round compact feet. Gait is free, active, and powerful. Imposing stature with gentle expression.

Very small slender toy sighthound measuring 33-38 cm at shoulder and weighing 2.5-5 kg. Head is long and narrow with flat skull and minimal stop. Ears are small, thin, and rose-shaped (folded back). Eyes are large, dark, oval, and expressive with alert gaze. Muzzle is long and refined. Body is extremely slender and elegant with deep narrow chest, arched loin, and visible abdominal tuck-up. Coat is short, fine, glossy, and close-lying, ranging from solid grey, black, red, fawn, cream, blue, to white. Tail is long, thin, tapering, and carried low with slight curve. Legs are extremely long, straight, and fine-boned with narrow hare feet. Gait is free, high-stepping, and graceful. Skin is thin and visible through coat.

Small slender sighthound measuring 44-51 cm at shoulder and weighing 9-14 kg. Head is long and lean with flat skull and minimal stop. Ears are small, thin, and rose-shaped (folded back against neck). Eyes are large, oval, dark, and alert with keen expression. Muzzle is long and powerful. Body is slender and athletic with deep narrow chest, pronounced abdominal tuck-up, and arched loin. Coat is short, smooth, dense, and close-lying, ranging from any color or combination: black, white, red, fawn, brindle, blue, parti-color. Tail is long, tapering, and carried low with slight upward curve. Legs are long, straight, and muscular with oval compact feet. Gait is free, low, smooth, and ground-covering with exceptional acceleration. Built for speed in short distances.

Slender agile medium-sized hound measuring 56-74 cm at shoulder and weighing 20-27 kg. Head is long and narrow with flat skull and minimal stop. Most distinctive feature is large erect ears, wide at base and pointed, carried upright and mobile. Eyes are amber-colored, small, and obliquely set creating alert expression. Muzzle is long and refined. Body is lean and athletic with deep chest, pronounced abdominal tuck-up, and arched loin. Coat is short and smooth (smooth variety) or longer and wiry (wire variety), ranging from red, white, red-and-white, or white with red markings. Tail is long, thin, and carried in distinctive ring or sickle curve above back. Legs are long, straight, and fine-boned with oval feet. Gait is free, elastic, and light-footed with unique springy bounce.

Compact medium-sized spitz-type dog measuring 46-52 cm at shoulder and weighing 20-25 kg. Head is broad and wedge-shaped with moderate stop and medium-length square muzzle. Ears are small, erect, pointed, and set high on head. Eyes are dark brown, medium-sized, and alert. Body is compact and well-balanced with deep chest, level topline, and tightly curled tail carried over back. Coat is double-layered: dense soft undercoat with coarse straight outer coat, creating weather-resistant texture. Coloration is uniform grey with darker tips: black guard hairs over lighter grey undercoat creating silver-grey appearance. Darker shading on back, lighter on underparts, legs, and tail. Tail is tightly curled and heavily coated. Legs are straight and sturdy with oval compact feet. Gait is free, effortless, and ground-covering.

Large hardy British hound measuring 58-69 cm at shoulder and weighing 27-52 kg. Head is large and domed with moderate stop and deep square muzzle. Ears are very long, pendulous, set low, and heavily folded. Eyes are dark or hazel, deep-set, with solemn expression. Body is powerful and substantial with deep chest, level topline, and moderate tuck-up. Coat is distinctive double-layered: long, coarse, shaggy outer coat (5-10 cm) over dense oily waterproof undercoat. Coloration ranges from any hound color: black-and-tan, grizzle, sandy, red, wheaten, or blue. Tail is long, slightly curved, and well-feathered, carried saber-like. Legs are straight, heavy-boned, with large webbed feet adapted for swimming. Gait is free, loose, and shambling. Webbed feet and oily coat distinguish as water-hunting breed.

Tall swift sighthound measuring 58-71 cm at shoulder and weighing 16-27 kg. Head is long and narrow with slight dome and minimal stop. Ears are long, pendulous, and heavily feathered, hanging close to head. Eyes are large, oval, dark to hazel, with soft dignified expression. Muzzle is long and refined. Body is slender and athletic with deep narrow chest, pronounced abdominal tuck-up, and arched loin. Coat is smooth and silky, with feathering on legs, thighs, and ears in feathered variety. Coloration ranges from white, cream, fawn, golden, red, grizzle, tricolor, to black-and-tan. Tail is long, low-set, and carried in gentle curve with feathering on underside. Legs are long, straight, and fine-boned with hare feet. Gait is free, smooth, and effortless with exceptional speed and endurance.

Very large rough-coated sighthound measuring 71-81 cm at shoulder and weighing 32-50 kg. Head is long and broad with flat skull and slight stop. Ears are small, set high, and folded back (rose ears). Eyes are dark, triangular, and soft with gentle expression. Muzzle is long and tapered. Body is tall and racy with deep chest, pronounced abdominal tuck-up, and arched loin. Coat is harsh, wiry, rough, and close-lying, ranging from blue-grey, dark blue, grey, brindle, yellow, sandy, red, or fawn. Neck is long and muscular with slight arch. Tail is long, tapering, and carried low with slight curve, reaching to ground. Legs are long, straight, and muscular with close compact feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering with effortless stride. Largest of sighthounds with gentle dignified demeanor.

Large smooth-coated hound measuring 56-69 cm at shoulder and weighing 25-40 kg. Most distinctive feature is uniform smooth greyish coat ranging from silver-grey to mouse-grey to blue-grey. Head is long and aristocratic with slight dome and moderate stop. Ears are long, lobular, set high, and hanging close to cheeks. Eyes are amber, grey, or blue-grey in puppies, maturing to light amber, creating intense penetrating gaze. Muzzle is long and powerful. Body is athletic and well-muscled with deep chest, level topline, and moderate tuck-up. Coat is short, smooth, dense, and sleek. Tail is docked (in traditional breed standard) or long, carried low. Legs are straight, muscular, and well-boned with webbed feet. Gait is free, smooth, and ground-covering. Entire coat should be solid grey with only small white markings on chest and toes permissible.

Medium-sized stocky muscular dog measuring 36-41 cm at shoulder and weighing 11-17 kg. Head is short and broad with pronounced cheek muscles, definite stop, and short broad muzzle. Ears are rose-shaped or half-pricked, set high. Eyes are round, dark, and alert with keen intelligent expression. Nose is black. Body is stocky, muscular, and well-balanced with broad chest, level topline, and deep ribs. Coat is short, smooth, glossy, and close-lying. Coloration ranges from red, fawn, white, black, blue, or any of these with white, with brindle patterns common. Tail is medium-length, low-set, tapering, and carried straight. Legs are straight, heavy-boned, and muscular with round compact feet. Gait is free, powerful, and agile with smooth drive. Broad skull and muscular build distinguish from other terriers.
